content.prompt: Draw a half-page version of the diagram to the right. Then use your ruler to carry out each of the following constructions.

spec.description: Two intersecting extended lines with unequally spaced points A, B, C on the descending line and X, Y, Z on the rising line, each ordered towards the unlabelled intersection. Coordinates encode a schematic reconstruction, not numerical givens.
spec.mathematics: A, B, C are collinear; X, Y, Z are collinear. The two supporting lines intersect beyond C and Z.
spec.answerVisibility: Only the supplied lines and six labelled points are visible.
